theme.title: Theme
ai.paste_help: ① ‘Copy AI prompt’ → paste it into ChatGPT, Claude… and describe the look (e.g. cherry blossom, pastel, rounded). ② Paste the whole answer here and press Apply. Don't like it? ‘Undo last theme’.
ai.copied: Prompt copied - paste it into an AI chat and describe the look you want
ai.copy_failed: Couldn't copy - open AI_THEME_PROMPT.md and copy it from there
set.lock: Lock layout (move/resize only in edit mode)
set.away_hint: If the PC sleeps this long while a stopwatch or pomodoro is counting, it asks whether that time counts.
set.hc: High contrast (strong outlines, no transparency, all buttons shown)
set.keys: Keyboard: Tab to move around · on a widget's ⋮⋮: arrows = move, Shift+arrows = resize, S = read summary, Delete = close · Menu key or Shift+F10 = right-click menu · F2 = edit item · Alt+↑/↓ in D-day = reorder · L in keyboard mode = list all
set.access_note: Everything here starts off. Turn on only what helps you - changes apply at once and can be turned off any time.
set.clickdrag: Move without dragging (click to pick up, click again to drop)
set.flash: Also flash the screen edge for alerts
set.notify: Also send alerts as Windows notifications
set.captions: Sound captions (show text while an alarm rings)
set.hints: Show a one-line how-to on every widget
set.announce: Add "Announce summary" to the widget right-click menu
set.short: Shorter lines in memo and diary
set.remind: Every day at this time, tell me what's left
upd.title: Updates
set.general.autostart_disabled: Windows has turned off startup for this app. Turning it on here re-enables it.
set.about.licenses_body: Readable fonts are bundled under the SIL Open Font License (OFL): Atkinson Hyperlegible, Lexend, OpenDyslexic.
set.timer.presets_hint: Shown in the timer's right-click menu › Quick start. Time: minutes (25), m:ss (1:30) or h:mm:ss (1:00:00). Label is optional.
set.cal.excluded_hint: Dates to hide even when they are public holidays.
set.cal.subs_hint: Paste another calendar's secret iCal link. In Google Calendar, copy "Settings for my calendars > Calendar settings > Integrate calendar > Secret address in iCal format". Imported entries are read-only. They update every 3 hours.
set.cal.sub_failed: Couldn't load. Hover for the reason.
set.cal.sub_bad_url: Enter a link that starts with https:// or webcal://.
set.backup.restore_hint: Restoring replaces current data and restarts the app. A pre-restore snapshot is saved first.
set.backup.confirm: Replace current data with this backup?
set.archive.hint: When on, memo text is saved as it changes (at most once a minute; at once when a memo is closed or mostly deleted). The archive survives erasing widgets and restoring backups. Turning it off keeps what is already saved.
set.backup.policy: Keeps the last {n} daily backups plus one weekly and one monthly backup. Of the backups made before a restore, the newest 5 are kept. Backups you make yourself and the one made before a data upgrade are never deleted.
set.backup.policy_off: Automatic backups are off. Backups you make yourself are kept.
set.backup.damaged: This backup is damaged ({file}), so nothing was restored. Pick another one.
set.layout_hint: Free placement: put widgets anywhere, right up to the screen edges, at any size, even overlapping. Dragging sticks to edges, the centre and other widgets; hold Alt to place exactly. Each layout mode keeps its own arrangement.
set.tutorial.replay_hint: Review the basics on a sample board. Nothing from the practice board is saved.
